count_method: A named-object occurrence is a JSON dictionary with a name key and an exact source title in its sources array. Occurrences are counted where stored, including repeated entities in separate files. File families are filename stems with trailing digits removed. PCGen reference counts are .lst directive lines in matching .pcc manifests; no-match means no Paizo Pathfinder manifest had a matching SOURCELONG or COPYRIGHT value. Related-only manifests are returned separately where they name an older similarly titled publication.
